status: Complete reconstructed proof of sharp square-root local scale, sharp below-window chi-square coefficient, and legitimate trace/KL lower bounds. No external validation or novelty claim.
independence: No thermal Curie-Weiss proof or root/integration application heuristic read before freeze. Direct exact spin-weight asymptotics and exact hypergeometric measurement route. Own frozen concentration theorem reused.
exact_model: N qubits on full tensor Hilbert space; rho_N=Z_N^-1 exp(2 J^2/N), J=(1/2)sum Pauli. PI and SU(2) invariant; tau=I/2.
spin_limit: j/N^(3/4) converges to X with density x^2 exp(-4x^4/3)/I0; all polynomial moments converge, both N parities.

results.below_window: chi_P^2=[2(Gamma(5/4)/Gamma(3/4))^2+o(1)]r(r-1)/N for 2<=r=o(sqrt(N)); KL=O(r^2/N), trace=O(r/sqrt(N)); r=1 all zero.
results.critical_window: For r/sqrt(N)->c>0 and any s>0, bounded cosine gap delta=e^(-s^2/2)[1-E sinc(2s sqrt(c)X)]>0, giving liminf trace>=delta/2 and liminf KL>=delta^2/2.
results.above_window: For r/sqrt(N)->infinity, any r<=N, trace->1 and KL>=[1/2-o(1)]log(r/sqrt(N))-log2->infinity.
results.exact_scale: Each of centered Petz chi-square, KL, and trace distance tends to zero if and only if r=o(sqrt(N)).

bounded_measurement: z-basis count, cosine of S_z(r)/sqrt(r) at critical scale; event |N^(1/4)S_z(r)/r|>(sqrt(N)/r)^(1/4) above window.

own_frozen_dependency.exact_use: Per-degree centered complex-Gram coefficient bound, with N-dependent B_N=sqrt(N); KL Jensen and trace HS inequalities.
